podcast.body: The first volume in this ongoing series was recorded in the summer of 1997 at the Rancho de la Luna studio in Joshua Tree, California. It was created by Josh Homme and friends jamming, conceived as an inspiration and fun jam rather than a permanent band. "Its official title is Instrumental Driving Music for Felons. Here's a sample. This is Girl Tom Boy."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Secrets of Queens of the Stone Age: Part 1
